leave_sick_days_001.evidence: Every teacher shall have ten (10) sick leave days during his/her first year in the system and eight (8) days sick leave each year thereafter.

leave_sick_accrual_002.evidence: A teacher may accumulate unused sick leave without limit

leave_sick_family_003.evidence: In any given year, seven (7) of such days may be used due to illness of any member of the teacher's immediate family
